note: TRIAL (reader review 4 Oct 2026, suggestions 13 to 15): ideas that span places. An idea is a term from data/terms.json (a material, method or system) or a pattern in Alexander's sense (a spatial or lived arrangement). A term idea's instances are every feature carrying one of its `terms`; a pattern idea's instances are its `members`, each assigned by hand with a fit (strong or loose) and a stance (follows or departs) and the source of the assignment. A pattern stores only its number, its name and a one-line paraphrase in our own words, never the book's text. scripts/build_ideas.py compiles each idea to data/ideas/<id>.json; agent-written text sits in data/ideas/written/<id>.json and is checked by scripts/check_ideas.py.

pattern.name: Entrance Transition
pattern.paraphrase: Arriving home goes through a distinct in-between space rather than straight from the street to the door.

members.basis: A deep roofed porch with a bench sits between the shared path and the front door.
A separate street-front building is passed on the way to the main house.
A planted gravel approach runs between the gatehouse and the main-house door.
The way in steps down to the lower rooms, a change of level after the door.
